title: Solar Battery
description: Solar Battery charges during the day and discharges at night.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Solar
learningObjectives: Explain why the battery charges when solar generation exceeds the load and discharges when it does not
Predict how the battery level changes over a full 24-hour cycle as the time-of-day slider sweeps from dawn to night
Compare the effects of the sun intensity and power drain sliders to find settings where the battery neither charges nor drains
Trace the direction of current flow shown by the animated electrons from solar cell to battery to load
Identify why energy storage is needed for a solar system that must supply power after sunset
